instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and sketch(es) you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by applying a Multi-Transform to the existing Pad feature. In the Multi-Transform, mirror the Pad across the supplied Sketch plane, then apply a Polar Pattern around the supplied Sketch axis with 3 occurrences over 360 degrees as shown. Apply a 5 mm fillet to the transformed part edges shown in the image. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
